# A component's own func keeps apart from the package's var of one name, on
# every target. A test build holds both in one namespace -- Android's state
# class, html's state object -- where `shown` was one member: Android compared
# a string with the package's int and its build failed, and html's state
# object had the var replaced by the func. passReservedNames renames the
# component's, as it renames one a target reserves.

sngl test --platform=none shared.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html shared.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go shared.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go shared.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go shared.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin shared.sngl
stdout '1 tests, 0 failures'
-- shared.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

var shown = 3

component counter ui.node {
    ui.button #more(text="{shown}", @click { shown += 1 })
}

component page ui.node {
    var form = "x"
    func shown() => "{form}!"
    func label() => shown() == "x!" ? "own" : "other"
    ui.vbox {
        ui.text #line(value=label())
        counter #count()
    }
}

func testOwnName(t test.Test, c page) {
    t.assert(c.line.value == "own")
    c.count.more.click()
    t.assert(c.count.more.text == "4")
}

ui.window {
    page()
}
